# AntiHunger

**Category:** Exploit  
**Aliases:** Anti Hunger, AntiHunger

## What it does

AntiHunger keeps your hunger and saturation from draining, so you can run, swim, and fight for long stretches without ever needing to eat. It works by hiding the actions that normally cost hunger from the server — mainly sprinting and standing on the ground — so the server never registers the exhaustion that would otherwise make your food bar tick down. Tested over long-distance travel, your hunger stays put even after thousands of blocks.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/exploit/antihunger). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
